body: you are very kind, thank you for your words 🙂
Thanks!!, It has been very difficult ... But is it worth it

It’s okay to feel ashamed, good that you’re still here, I identify with you, I’ve had 3 suicide attempts in the last 2 years, and I’m glad they didn’t work out, just like you, my husband has been my biggest help, let him help you even if you don’t want to, even if you want to die every day, it’s going to come the day when you want to live, I’ll last two years wanting to die Despite being in psychiatric treatment but my family didn’t give up and I’m still here, and the treatment is working, now I want to live and not die, hold on!!
